newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska signs 725 mln SKR bridge order.
newsitem.headline: Skanska signs 725 mln SKR bridge order.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska AB on Friday said it had signed a 725 million crown order for a Swedish bridge project.
"The order sum amounts to 725 million crowns," Skanska said in a statement.
The cable-stayed Sunningesund bridge would be part of a new highway on the west coast of Sweden, the E6, and would be 1,712 metres long, it said.
"Construction work will start in May 1997 and is due for completion in May 2000," Skanska said.
Skanska is also involved in construction of other bridges, including the Oresund which will be the first link of Sweden to Denmark and so to the European continent.
